gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-osmany: Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet, its letters held apart by wide bridges and its lowercase standing tall and loud. Noto Sans Osmanya does the quieter job, with sans-serif curves that turn easily.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-pahawh: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sits high on its x-height, with rounds that gap open. Snowburst One brings the stencil bridges and a tall, bold lowercase, so the heading shouts while the sans text keeps its cool underneath.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-palmyr: Stencil punch, then a quiet turn. Snowburst One breaks its letters with wide bridges, and Noto Sans Palmyrene follows with curves that stop short of closing and ascenders kept compact.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-pau-ci: Snowburst One cuts its tall lowercase like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges splitting each letter into bold pieces. And Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau lets its open-ended sans curves breathe, with capitals only a short step above the lowercase.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-phagsp: Noto Sans PhagsPa keeps its openings see-through, with capitals rising only a gentle bump above the small letters. But Snowburst One, with its stencil bridges and tall lowercase, supplies the loudness, and that gap in volume is the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-phoeni: Noto Sans Phoenician has generous lowercase height and s curves that open wide at both ends. Over a full page of text it would feel modern and unhurried, while Snowburst One's stencil bridges stay up top making noise.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-psalte: Snowburst One is a bold stencil sheet, its wide bridges cutting every tall lowercase letter. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi sits below with gaping mouths on the e and capitals that barely rise, approachable where the heading is loud.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Lowercase counters here look like wide glass portholes, with gaps you can see through in c, e, s and a. Noto Sans Rejang is the plain-spoken half, and Snowburst One's stencil bridges supply all the drama.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-runic: Neutral is the first word for the text face here, a big x-height with curves that never close back on themselves. Across a full page it stays quiet and modern beside the loud stencil heading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-samari: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet in bold. Its wide bridges and tall lowercase meet Noto Sans Samaritan, a sans-serif with hefty lowercase and plenty of daylight inside its curves, and that mix of shout and warmth is what holds the pair together.
